verdict.rationale: Alias or masked-address support is a fair question for an email client, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack shows Superhuman Mail creating aliases, masked addresses, or relay addresses that hide the user's real address. The documented features cover AI triage, drafting, calendar, MCP and team tools, and the privacy-related community items concern read-tracking pixels, not address masking.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can use aliases or masked addresses so sign-ups and strangers never learn my real address
